verdict.rationale: uv installs Python and switches between versions. `uv python pin` writes a checked-in `.python-version` file per project, uv respects the pinned version, and it downloads Python versions as needed. Community users report it replaces pyenv and that `uv run` handles the Python install automatically. Missing for 10: managing runtimes other than Python, and first-party docs explicitly showing auto-install triggered by the pinned file (beyond the brief 'respect the Python version pinned' line).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install and switch language runtimes or tool versions per project from a checked-in config file

citations.quote: uv installs Python and allows quickly switching between versions.
This will respect the Python version pinned in the project.
The venv and your Python install are just handled for you by 'uv run', which is magic.
